attempts.summary: Created "Fleet Internal CA" on node1 (self-signed root, 4096-bit RSA, 10y validity), issued a TLS server cert to node2 (CN=node2, SAN=DNS:node2/IP:10.100.36.11, signed by the CA), deployed it to node2 and configured node2 to serve HTTPS on port 8443 (systemd-managed Python2/ssl HTTP server, cert readable, firewalld port 8443/tcp opened). Installed the CA cert as a trusted system CA on both node1 and node2 via /etc/pki/ca-trust + update-ca-trust, verified curl trusts node2's cert with no --cacert override on both nodes. Ran the mandatory node-restart protocol: captured boot_id/service/trust/HTTPS baselines on both nodes, restarted node1 then node2 one at a time via `shutdown -r now`, confirmed boot_id changed on each, and confirmed fleet-https.service (enabled+active), CA trust anchor, firewall port, and HTTPS 200 response all recovered post-reboot on both nodes.
